Triage audit — **run-record, labeled `tracking`; the four FAILs are split to execution cards in the repo where the fix lands** (file-at-destination rule; all four root-cause in vendored-console/objectui code, each re-verified at objectui `origin/main` @ `92c0b1f` before filing):

| QA item | Execution card | Verified anchor |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `kanban-drag-persistence` | objectstack-ai/objectui#4138 | `ObjectKanban.tsx:589` revert gated on `!hasExternalData` |
| `saved-view-management` | objectstack-ai/objectui#4139 | `data-objectstack/src/index.ts:3012` read without draft qualifier, create-equivalent catch |
| `bulk-select-all-matching` | objectstack-ai/objectui#4140 | `ObjectGrid.tsx:2956`/`:2994` omit the `selectionResetKey` bump `:1946` performs |
| `upload-guard-blocks-confirm` | objectstack-ai/objectui#4141 | guard exists in `FileField.tsx:52`; `paramToField.ts:85` delivers `maxSize` to both widgets |

The one framework-side observation (`object-hook-lifecycle` PARTIAL, `ctx.log` output unobservable) is recorded as #7448 (`finding` + `domain:cli`, anchored `body-runner.ts:339`/`:377`).

Dedup: searched objectui open issues per defect (kanban / updateView / clear-selection / maxSize) — zero duplicates; #4025 (kanban `$top`) and ui#4110 (InboxPopover) are different defects. `tracking` on this card keeps the run record out of the triage scan window, matching how the two prior QA-run records (#7399, #7326 — both all-pass) exited via close; this one stays open as the aggregation record until its four cards land. Fixture gaps listed in the body are QA-harness work, not dispatchable defects — left with the record.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

Closing — extraction has been complete since the 2026-08-10 triage pass (four FAILs → objectstack-ai/objectui#4138–#4141, the framework observation → #7448), and each card has its own lifecycle in the objectui queue.

One disposition superseded, recorded rather than silently overridden: the triage comment above kept this record open "until its four cards land". Maintainer instruction of 2026-08-11 (chat, verbatim): 「QA run 相关的 issue 如果任务已经分拆出去了，是不是应该直接关闭」 — ruled that an extracted run record closes at extraction, not at its cards' landing; the cards' progress is tracked on the cards. Same exit as the all-pass run records #7399 / #7326.
